messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get

message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock, so I can’t give you an exact minute‑by‑minute answer.  
On July 16, 2026 New York City is on Eastern Daylight Time (UTC‑4). If you know the current UTC time, just subtract four hours to get the local time in NYC.  

If you’d like a quick way to check, you can look at the clock on your phone, computer, or a reliable world‑time website.
